facts.fact: JOB_LIST supplies the child Job handles in their assignment order. Attribute value storage must remain valid until the list is destroyed. The page does not document this combination with SECURITY_ENVIRONMENT.
facts.scope: Generic documented process-creation attribute contract; not CPSE combination evidence.

facts.fact: API success and membership are distinct: a successful call can return membership false. A non-null Job handle queries that exact Job; a null handle asks about any Job.
facts.scope: The observed child_not_in_owned_job is raised after API success and false membership in the project's source.

facts.fact: The PARENT_PROCESS entry describes inheritance from a nominated parent, including its Job. The actual CPSE effective parent or service path was not observed in actual02.
facts.scope: Do not infer a broker PID or that ordinary caller Job inheritance necessarily applies to this combination.

facts.fact: Pinned G creates the process suspended, then creates a UiJobObject and assigns the returned process before resume. On assignment failure it directly terminates and reaps the held process.
facts.scope: This is implementation evidence for a post-create gate. It does not prove JOB_LIST atomic attachment and is not permission to replace the project's atomic gate.

facts.fact: Pinned G uses NONE0. Its comment acknowledges a terminate-on-close bit but intentionally does not declare the numeric value; it explicitly closes after child exit.
facts.scope: No pinned upstream terminate-on-close or hard caller-crash mechanism is established by this code.

facts.fact: The current Microsoft page enumerates NONE and TERMINATE_ON_CLOSE but gives no behavioral description of caller death, crash cancellation, service ownership or reopen/recovery.
facts.scope: The name alone is insufficient proof that killing a caller closes its opaque environment or stops a child outside Jobs.

facts.fact: The documented close returns VOID. The page does not provide a result or an external absence/caller-crash guarantee.
facts.scope: Actual normal return is a caller API obligation receipt, not independent environment absence or broker cancellation.

actual02_boundary.raw_job_result: one exact Job membership false; exact Job unknown

minimum_code_only_observation.scope: Separate read-only observations before retaining the same original all-true Job admission gate.
sequence: Before any observation, hold the original returned process handle and original PI; independently read kernel PID, creation time and fixed image/hash, bracketed by generation/liveness and original QPC checks.
Query exact inner Job once and preserve API-success separately from membership and immediate Win32 error. Do not turn false into an exception before the second read-only observation is recorded.
Open the exact original named outer Job with QUERY access; query membership separately. Scope and once-close this new query handle and record close outcome. Never inherit or retain it across cleanup.

Bind both observations to source/config/spec/native returned-PI and receipt SHA, original run/F/T0/D, exact Job role/name commitment, held generation and image commitment. Save raw private observations before raising any admission error.
Require both successful queries with membership true plus the original Job limits and handle-ownership checks. Keep false, unknown, stale generation, uncertain close or deadline as rejection.

Do not ResumeThread, perform AccessCheck, create the LPAC second arm, auto-assign either Job, change policy/capabilities, use a null Job as an exact Job substitute, or repeat automatically after rejection.
minimum_code_only_observation.public_projection: Only per-role query-known/membership/close/timing booleans and raw commitments; no private identifiers.

crash_boundary.if_inner_true_outer_false: A still-owned non-inherited KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE inner Job may protect its members when the worker dies, but actual02 did not separately record this membership. The original dual-Job predicate still rejects.
crash_boundary.if_inner_false: Do not assume the outer kill or inner Job closure covers the created process. Normal direct TerminateProcess cleanup is not evidence for the interval before the returned handle is transferred or a caller crashes.
no_invented_repair: A caller-owned raw process HANDLE is not automatically a crash-terminating resource.
A second observer receiving a duplicated handle after CreateProcess returns leaves the earlier creation/transfer interval unproved.
Pinned Rust Drop runs on normal lifetime paths; it is not evidence of cleanup on hard process termination.

TERMINATE_ON_CLOSE must not be guessed into a flag or used to waive Job membership. Any future use needs a separate fixed contract/variant and a mechanism that actually establishes caller-crash behavior.

Generic JOB_LIST permits an ordered explicit Job list. A future exact outer-plus-inner constructor would be a new reviewed native ABI/artifact and request, with readback required; it is not demonstrated by this run.
